Roles and permissions

Applicants see only their own offer or waitlist status. Coordinators set capacity, issue offers and approve enrollment.

Build prompt

Build “Program Waitlist & Enrollment Manager” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Track confirmed, offered and waiting places separately. Reserve one seat for each active offer. On cancellation, invite the earliest eligible applicant using a configurable response window. Applicants see only their own offer or waitlist status. Coordinators set capacity, issue offers and approve enrollment. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

With two confirmed seats and one waitlisted applicant, a cancellation creates one offer. Accepting it restores two confirmed seats. Retrying acceptance leaves enrollment at two.

This listing is a build brief. Use its prompt to plan an app in your own NeoApps account.
